name: liquid-build
title: Liquid Build: construction estimates and help
description: Liquid Build is an AI-powered general contractor and developer in South Florida. We develop single-family communities and build custom homes, commercial build-outs, schools and data centers across Miami-Dade, Broward and Palm Beach counties. We use AI to answer faster, estimate faster and keep permits moving, and experienced builders run every job.

tools.name: get_company_info
tools.description: Who we are, services, service area, contact details and track record.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: Past projects with type, location and scope.

tools.name: get_ballpark_estimate
tools.description: Rough cost range for a project type, size, finish level and location. Not a bid.

tools.name: ground_project_idea
tools.description: Turn an idea into a grounded plan: permits, South Florida code issues (HVHZ, flood zones), phases, timeline, risks and questions to answer.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Send your project to our team. We reply within one business day by phone, text or email.
